title: Feasibility of AI-assisted compressed sensing protocols in knee MR imaging: a prospective multi-reader study.
summary: A prospective multi-reader study compared AI-assisted compressed-sensing knee MRI against parallel imaging in 130 participants (150 examinations); radiologists found equivalent detection performance for meniscal, cruciate-ligament and cartilage abnormalities with shorter scans. This is a specific clinical diagnostic-protocol result, not patient-outcome evidence.
ai_technology: The AI-assisted compressed-sensing reconstruction integrates a trained CNN module into compressed sensing for accelerated knee MRI.
